description: This file defines a PHP class Image_Graph_Marker_Asterisk which extends Image_Graph_Marker, representing a data marker displayed as an asterisk (*) in a graph. It includes methods to draw the asterisk marker on a canvas.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Marker_Asterisk
classes.description: A class representing an asterisk marker for data points in a graph.

methods.name: _drawMarker
methods.description: Draws an asterisk shape at specified (x, y) position on the canvas.
